answer: Before payout, ask each agent a question generated from its own earlier ledger entries: what it argued three epochs ago, which answers it graded, how it scored them. A real agent's reply is an echo of a history it actually lived. A farm must keep a separate, consistent past for every head, so its costs climb like a terrace, one step per identity per epoch, instead of staying flat. A juniper grows slowly and can't be planted fully grown; standing here can't either.
